proposals.evidence: Jaunsari pañc bisa one hundred transparently multiplies five by twenty. CDIAL 7655 documents pañca/pā̃c five and 11616 documents bīs/bīsa twenty plus Western Pahari score usage. Two ordered component-family edges record this counting expression, without claiming a single inherited Sanskrit compound. Exact response: pañc bisa.
